indicator_name: Money multiplier (M2 and M3 over the monetary base), cash share of M3 (computed by this repository)
description: Денежный мультипликатор (M2 и M3 к денежной базе), доля наличных в M3 (расчёт репозитория)
methodology: From the NBK's M0, M2, M3 and MONETARY_BASE (stocks, monthly from 1994). M2_SHARE_M3: the rest of M3 is other deposits in foreign currency.
